name: Carbon Black Endpoint Standard Event Collector
summary: From vendor docs. Alert search for the event collector.
notes: POST /api/alerts/v7/orgs/{org_key}/alerts/_search returns { results, num_found }. This matches the Endpoint Standard alerts mock and adds the collector integration.
attribution: Checked against a public vendor reference or, when that page is blocked, the integration test fixture plus the public client. See /presets/ATTRIBUTION.md.
